{{Short description|Italian mathematician and physicist (1747–1812)}}
[[File:Cocoli_-_Proposizioni_fisico-matematiche,_1775_-_1831.jpg|thumb|''Proposizioni fisico-matematiche'', 1775]]

'''Domenico Cocoli''' ([[Brescia]], 12 August 1747 – 27 November 1812) was an Italian [[mathematician]]<ref>{{cite book|language=de|article=Cocoli, Domenico|title=Biographisches Lexikon des Kaiserthums Österreich|volume=2|url=http://www.literature.at/viewer.alo?objid=11806&viewmode=fullscreen&scale=3.33&rotate=&page=400|date=1857|publisher=Verlag der typografisch-literarisch-artistischen Anstalt|location=Wien|pages=398–399}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://d-nb.info/gnd/1050675851|title=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek|website=d-nb.info|language=de|access-date=2017-06-14}}</ref> and [[physicist]], especially active on [[hydraulics]].<ref name="Corniani">{{cite book|language=it|author=Giambattista Corniani|article=Cocoli Domenico|title=I secoli della letteratura italiana dopo il suo risorgimento|volume=2|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=TizhDZ2lVUkC&pg=PA463|date=1833|publisher=Vincenzo Ferrario|location=Milano|page=463}}</ref> He was a top physicist of the late [[Republic of Venice]], then of the [[Italian Republic (Napoleonic)|Napoleonic Italian Republic]].<ref name="Corniani" />

== Biography ==
Born in [[Brescia]] in 1747, he began studying [[architecture]] and later was awarded a pension by a wealthy patron to continue his studies.<ref name="Corniani" /> In 1774 he had the chair of physics and mathematics. In 1777 he published his ''Elements of Geometry and Trigonometry''.<ref name="Corniani" /> Thanks to the fame of the book, he became a consultant of the [[Republic of Venice]] being among the five physicists who took care of the problem of the floodings of the [[Brenta river]].<ref name="Corniani" /> Until 1797 he carried out various assignments.<ref name="Corniani" /> In 1802 he was appointed member of the ''Collegio dei Dotti'' of the [[Italian Republic (Napoleonic)|Napoleonic Italian Republic]].<ref name="Corniani" />In 1806 he became a general inspector inside the "''Corpo di Acque e Strade''", always inside the Napoleonic Italian Republic.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Corpo di acque e strade |url=https://idraulica.beic.it/protagonisti/il-corpo-napoleonico-di-acque-e-strade/}}</ref>
